title: artanthe anonifolia
intro: Artanthe anonifolia, commonly known as the "False Calabar Bean" or "False Calabar Nut," is a plant native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiparasitic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Artanthe anonifolia include relieving pain, reducing fever, and treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
